reconstruction_summary: Re-ran the agent's V4 stack (their declared best): linear-ST yaw rate with the agent's saved fit Cα (Cαf=312267, Cαr=318880 N/rad from out/ladder_results.json) plus per-segment straight-line yaw-bias correction plus a LOSO Ridge(α=1) residual learner on [v,|a_y|,|δ|,sign(δ̇)], using per-platform L/l_f/l_r/m/I_z from PARAM_BY_PLATFORM.
notes: Agent's Cα fit (Cαf=312267, Cαr=318880) was tuned on 80 Mach-E segments only; we apply it to all 545 canonical Ford segments (315 Mach-E + 230 F-150) — F-150 uses Mach-E-tuned Cα as that is what the agent shipped, which somewhat undersells F-150 fidelity. Per-segment yaw bias and LOSO Ridge are computed across the full canonical pool. Baseline sanity-check matches cached canonical V0 to <1e-9.
